decisions.scenario: Booking a Saturday train from Cambridge to Bishops Stortford after 16:30

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Cambridge to Bishops Stortford on Saturday, leaving after 16:30.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There is a train leaving Cambridge at 17:29 and arriving in Bishops Stortford at 18:07.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That works. Please book three tickets.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The three tickets were booked successfully.

decisions.notes: Retained because the Saturday 17:29-to-18:07 Cambridge-to-Bishops Stortford schedule and three-ticket booking add new reviewed train coverage. The synthetic booking reference was omitted.

decisions.scenario: Checking a Sunday train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street before 17:30

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street on Sunday, arriving by 17:30.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR6908 is one option and arrives in Birmingham New Street at 16:44.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: What are the travel time and ticket price for TR6908?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The journey takes 163 minutes, and the ticket price is £60.08.

decisions.notes: Retained because TR6908 and its Sunday 16:44 arrival add a new Cambridge-to-Birmingham schedule point; the source also supplies the 163-minute travel time and £60.08 fare.

decisions.scenario: Checking a Sunday afternoon train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street after 15:00

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Cambridge to Birmingham New Street on Sunday after 15:00.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There is a train leaving Cambridge at 15:01 and arriving at Birmingham New Street at 17:44.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How much is the ticket for that train?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The ticket price is £60.08, payable at the station.

decisions.notes: Retained because the Sunday 15:01 departure and 17:44 arrival add a new Cambridge-to-Birmingham schedule pair distinct from previously reviewed Sunday service.
